The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Multiple cells in the range H46:L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical values (e.g., H46 expected -1.653, got #NAME?). This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, incorrect function syntax, or missing references. While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived statistics calculations are broken.
